title: Zuljanah
body:
Zuljanah
Zuljanah. Ay zuljanah. Zuljanah. Ay zuljanah.
<<MINI>>
(Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujo baba husaina) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Gumshuda baba kuja. Zuljana bigoh. Ah cha shud baba raa. Zuljanah bigoh. jood bigo majarah. Zuljanah bigoh.
<<MINI>>
(Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujaan baba husaina) x2
Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujaan baba husaina
Gumshuda baba kujaa......
Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujan baba husaina
Gumshuda baba kujaa......
Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujan baba husaina
Gumshuda baba kujaa.........
Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujan baba husaina
Gumshuda baba kujaa.............
<<DIVIDER>>
(Zuljanah tera, haye ye rona) x2 Karta he mushkil ab mera jina. (Puch rahi hai, tujse sakina) x2 Bol kaha he mera baba.
(chor ke tanha, aya jo tu he) x2 Math-e pe tere, kiska lahu hai. (Isme to mere baba ki bu hai) x2. Bol kaha hai mera baba.
(aath pahar se, pyasa tha baba) x2 Lasho pe lashe, laya tha baba (Zakhmi badan tha, zakhmi kaleja) x2 Bol kaha he mera baba.
(Pehle hi tujse, mene kaha tha) x2 Baba ko mere, run me na layja (Haye na mana, tu mera kehna) x2 Bol kaha he mera baba
(Zuljanah lay chal, baba jaha he) x2 Itna bataa de, soye kaha he (Tujko pataa he, wo meri jaan hai) x2 bol kaha he mara baba
<<MINI>>
Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujan baba husaina
Gumshuda baba kujaa.............
<<DIVIDER>>
(Jab tu chalaa tha, baba ko lay kar) x2 Yaad to hoga, tujko wo manzar (Tere sumon se, lipti thi rokar) x2 Bol kaha he mera baba
<<MINI>>
Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujan baba husaina
Gumshuda baba kujaa.......
Zuljanah, zuljanah, bigo kujo baba husaina
